scope: Cryptocurrency Perpetual Futures (Binance USDT-M): 1m/3m/Intraday Candlestick TA, Conditional Probability & HMM Regime Switching, CUSUM + Triple-Barrier Labeling, Order Flow Imbalance (OFI), Maker/Taker Adverse Selection & Walk-Forward Profitability Verification

papers.title: Are Simple Technical Trading Rules Profitable in Bitcoin Markets?
papers.venue: International Review of Economics & Finance, Vol. 93, pp. 858-874
papers.key_finding: Tests 75,360 simple technical trading rules across daily and intraday frequencies with FDR multiple-hypothesis control and realistic transaction costs; portfolios of FDR-selected rules outperform buy-and-hold out-of-sample on a risk-adjusted basis.
papers.implementation_rule: Never deploy unvalidated technical rules; require out-of-sample post-cost selection and combine orthogonal rules rather than single indicator triggers.

papers.title: Technical analysis in cryptocurrency markets: Do transaction costs and bubbles matter?
papers.venue: Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money, Vol. 79
papers.key_finding: Evaluates 69 technical rules on daily and 1-minute returns (2016-2021) with and without transaction costs; costs dramatically erode altcoin profitability while BTC/ETH liquidity retains structural edge.
papers.implementation_rule: Focus 1m/3m execution on highest-liquidity USDT-M pairs (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT) and enforce explicit per-pair fee gates.

papers.title: Intraday price forecasts using candlestick patterns in cryptocurrency markets
papers.venue: International Review of Economics & Finance, Vol. 108
papers.key_finding: Documents intraday predictive power of candlestick reversal/continuation patterns in crypto when conditioned on prevailing trend definition and holding horizon.
papers.implementation_rule: Condition candlestick patterns (wick sweep / pin bar / engulfing) on higher-timeframe trend state rather than trading isolated candles.

papers.title: Visual Chart Representations for Cryptocurrency Regime Prediction: A Systematic Deep Learning Study
papers.key_finding: Raw candlestick spatial geometry on BTC/ETH (2018-2024) achieves 0.892 AUC-ROC for regime classification, outperforming complex encodings.
papers.implementation_rule: Encode clean OHLC candlestick geometry (body ratio, upper/lower wick ratios, range expansion) directly into the regime/conditional probability state.

papers.title: Algorithmic crypto trading using information-driven bars, triple barrier labeling and deep learning
papers.key_finding: On 2018-2023 BTC/ETH tick data, combining CUSUM event filtering with Triple-Barrier labeling outperforms fixed-time next-bar prediction and stays net-profitable after transaction costs.
papers.implementation_rule: Filter 1m/3m noise bars with a volatility-scaled CUSUM / structural-candle trigger and label conditional probabilities via Triple-Barrier (TP hit before SL within vertical time limit).

papers.title: Multi-Timeframe Feature Engineering for Bitcoin Market Prediction: A Price-Level-Agnostic Machine Learning Approach
papers.authors: MDPI Machine Learning and Knowledge Extraction
papers.key_finding: Proves that merging higher-timeframe (HTF) candles onto lower-timeframe bars without shifting HTF bars by 1 completed period inflates ROC-AUC by +0.20 (lookahead bias); causal MTF alignment significantly reduces maximum drawdown.
papers.implementation_rule: Strictly shift resampled 15m/1h higher-timeframe indicators by 1 completed bar before merging onto 1m/3m execution bars; normalize all features price-level-agnostically (ratios/ATR/z-scores).

papers.title: Machine Learning-Based Bitcoin Trading Under Transaction Costs: Evidence From Walk-Forward Forecasting
papers.key_finding: Shows intraday Bitcoin models frequently exhibit positive gross edge that turns negative net of transaction costs due to high turnover; walk-forward evaluation must directly optimize net-of-cost utility.
papers.implementation_rule: Enforce walk-forward OOS net-of-cost Profitability Gate before live deployment and include switching/turnover penalty directly in action selection.

papers.title: The Market Maker's Dilemma: Navigating the Fill Probability vs. Post-Fill Returns Trade-Off
papers.key_finding: Taker strategies are constrained by prohibitive fees, while passive Maker orders suffer adverse selection unless timed when order-book/flow imbalance begins reverting.
papers.implementation_rule: Use Maker-First (POST_ONLY) execution on liquidity-sweep / OFI-reversal setups, and block passive limit entries during extreme one-sided momentum cascades.

papers.title: Explainable Patterns in Cryptocurrency Microstructure
papers.key_finding: Using 1-second Binance Futures perpetual data (2022-2025), documents portable cross-asset SHAP patterns in Order Flow Imbalance (OFI), spread, and VWAP deviation, plus flash-crash divergence between Maker and Taker execution.
papers.implementation_rule: Include signed Order Flow Imbalance (Binance taker_buy_base_vol) and VWAP deviation in 1m/3m feature states.

papers.title: Short-horizon mean reversion in cryptocurrency markets: a matched cross-market measurement
papers.key_finding: Measures short-horizon reversal on Binance USDT-M perpetuals using kline taker-buy base volume and funding history, isolating liquidity-provision edge vs. informed flow.
papers.implementation_rule: Extract Binance kline taker_buy_base_volume directly during data ingestion to compute real Taker Imbalance = 2*(taker_buy/total_vol) - 1.

papers.title: Regime-switching in bitcoin volatility under global uncertainty: Markov-switching GARCH and hidden Markov Copula approaches
papers.venue: Research in International Business and Finance, Vol. 83
papers.key_finding: Confirms Bitcoin operates under sharp volatility regime switches; conditioning strategy parameters and risk scaling on latent regime improves robustness.
papers.implementation_rule: Scale position size inversely with realized volatility regime and separate high-vol vs. normal-vol conditional probability posteriors.

papers.title: Momentum in the Cryptocurrency Market: A Comprehensive Analysis under Realistic Assumptions
papers.venue: Review of Asset Pricing Studies (Oxford Academic)
papers.key_finding: Under daily mark-to-market liquidation risk, time-series momentum on major cryptocurrencies remains robust whereas leveraged cross-sectional altcoin portfolios frequently liquidate.
papers.implementation_rule: Prioritize time-series trend/reversion on liquid majors (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT) with fixed initial hard stops and conservative leverage.

papers.title: Fundamentals of Perpetual Futures
papers.authors: Songrun He, Asaf Manela, Omri Ross, Victor von Wachter
papers.key_finding: Derives no-arbitrage perpetual funding bounds and shows funding rate deviations reflect leveraged directional crowding.
papers.implementation_rule: Account for 8h funding rate carry in walk-forward PnL and throttle longs/shorts during extreme crowded funding.

papers.title: Crypto Carry
papers.authors: Maik Schmeling, Andreas Schrimpf, Karamfil Todorov
papers.key_finding: Documents high crypto carry premia accompanied by severe left-tail crash risk during crowded unwinding.
papers.implementation_rule: Apply conformal / tail-risk position scaling and hard stop-loss caps to prevent left-tail liquidation.
